If two digits can appear only in the same two cells of a row, column, or box, those cells are reserved for that hidden pair. Remove every other candidate from the two cells.
If three cells in one unit contain candidates drawn from the same three digits, those digits are reserved for the three cells. Remove those digits from other cells in that unit.
If three digits are restricted to the same three cells of a unit, keep only those three digits in the source cells and remove their other candidates.

When a digit is limited to the same two columns in each of two rows, or the same two rows in each of two columns, the four source cells form an X-Wing. Remove that digit from the other cells on the matching lines.
